criteria.requirement: Add treelib.snapshot.snapshot(tree) and restore(document,tree_class=Tree,**tree_kwargs) using schema=1/root/nodes flat records with id/tag/parent/ordered children/expanded/data. Include all descendants regardless of expanded and preserve duplicate tags and sibling insertion order. Validate exact supported shape/version, unique nonempty string IDs, one coherent root, bidirectional parent/children relationships, no cycles/duplicate references/missing or unreachable nodes, and explicit empty-tree representation before returning a tree. Restore a fresh explicitly selected tree class without dynamic class execution; copy data ownership and preserve falsy data. Keep old to_json/from_json display format unchanged. Plain data must be JSON-compatible for actual JSON encoding; no arbitrary class codecs are implied.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
